## What it is
Minimal-scope responsive fix for MvoxNav. PO on mobile couldn't reach logout because the desktop-only nav pushed the avatar (CHORE-75 menu) off-screen. Fix: avatar always anchored/visible; below `sm` the 5 tab labels collapse behind a hamburger paper-card menu; OrgPicker chip truncates (also closes #65). Desktop (`sm`+) unchanged.

- **a11y parity** — hamburger menu reuses the AvatarMenu focus-on-open + Escape + click-outside pattern (the YELLOW-75.1 pattern). Confirm keyboard nav is genuinely equivalent, not just structurally present.

Send verdict (RED/YELLOW/GREEN) with rationale + who-acts. Then idle.

[2026-05-31 13:55] Review request — CHORE-77 (issue #77), branch `chore/nav-stacking-fix`. Task #8 yours.

## What/why
Regression fix for CHORE-76 (`da00b06`). The `overflow-x-hidden` we added to `<header>` forced `overflow-y: auto` (CSS spec), clipping BOTH dropdown panels (AvatarMenu logout + nav-tab-menu) on desktop AND mobile — logout was unreachable again. Fix removes the clip, adds `relative z-30` to the header for a proper stacking context above page content.

## Branch chain
- `5473953` Tallis RED — revised the AC7 test (it had asserted the buggy `overflow-x-hidden`), +2 stacking tests, +1 forward-guard
- `316ff02` Byrd GREEN — single-line `<header>` change (`-overflow-x-hidden +relative +z-30`), 579/579

## Please verify
- AC1–AC6 (issue #77): no block-axis clip on header; header forms a stacking context (`relative` + `z-30`) above unpositioned page content (`{@render children()}` / DeskSurface); horizontal overflow still controlled by `min-w-0`/truncate + `flex-shrink-0` (NOT a header clip); both panels structurally unclipped; desktop no-regression.
- **Confirm the AC7 test-intent change is sound** — the prior test encoded the bug; the revised assertion (header must NOT carry overflow clip) is the correct contract. Was this a legitimate RED-phase revision vs something that should've been a new test? Your call.
- `z-30` adequacy: page content/DeskSurface is unpositioned (Finn confirmed no transform/filter/opacity/isolation stacking traps on ancestors), so z-30 should win. Flag if you see any positioned/z-indexed content sibling that could still beat it.
- Per-commit-GREEN + merge-shape.

Verdict + rationale. Then idle.
